The Indian financial system; which refers to the borrowing and lending
of funds Or to the demand for and supply of funds of ali individuals,

viz , the Indian money market and the Indian capital market:
The Indian money market is the market in which short-term funds are
borrowed and lent: The capital market in India, on the other hand, is
the market for medium-term and long- term funds_
The Indian  financial   system  performs crucial role in economic
development of India through saving-investment process, also known
as capital formation:
